evidence_text:
Comparison brief: Vellmar Feature Store vs Oakrun Feature Store
evidence_dose=-2 (positive ⇒ more points favour Vellmar Feature Store)

- p1: online read p99 (ms): Vellmar Feature Store=11.4  | Oakrun Feature Store=6.1 ← better
- p2: backfill throughput (rows/s): Vellmar Feature Store=610000  | Oakrun Feature Store=920000 ← better
- p3: point-in-time correctness suite pass: Vellmar Feature Store=0.94  | Oakrun Feature Store=0.99 ← better
- p4: storage cost ($/TB/mo): Vellmar Feature Store=26  | Oakrun Feature Store=18 ← better
- p5: feature freshness lag (s): Vellmar Feature Store=20 ← better | Oakrun Feature Store=45
- p6: schema migration downtime (s): Vellmar Feature Store=35  | Oakrun Feature Store=0 ← better
- p7: supported sink types (count): Vellmar Feature Store=19 ← better | Oakrun Feature Store=12
- p8: training/serving skew incidents per quarter: Vellmar Feature Store=4  | Oakrun Feature Store=1 ← better

Tally: Vellmar Feature Store better on 2/8; Oakrun Feature Store better on 6/8.
